prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in to post-adoption (+13.3%) or post-certificate (+5.8%), adding account recovery copy (+4.2%), and multi-device sync banners (+2.7%) were helpful; post-waiting room sign-in hurt (-3.9%), while other sync hints had no clear effect.
Path clarity headline updates (+5.9%), story stage visual redesigns (+5.9%), and spotlight layouts (+2.7%) were helpful, while copy simplifications, value refreshes, time expectation banners, and showcase layouts showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%), background readiness status (+3.3%), visibility status checks (+4.7%), and spawn location hints (+4.5%) were helpful; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.
Companion previews paired with photo quality guides (+7.6%) or split upload layouts (+8.1%) were helpful; compact grid layouts (-7.7%), photo fallback flows (-11.8%), guidelines banners (-5.0%), and mascot stamp redesigns (-24.1%) hurt results.
System tray location tips (+3.8%) were helpful, whereas direct controls guides (-14.4%) and first interaction tips (-6.5%) made results worse; mascot welcome stages, interaction badges, tray controls tips, and docking hints showed no clear effect.
Predictions overpredicted severe negative impacts (such as mascot stamp redesigns and direct controls guides) while underpredicting large wins from headline updates, visual redesigns, and companion preview layouts.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Home Desktop Spawn Placement Flow: Add an interactive desktop placement test stage to the home intro screen so users can preview and position their pet before completion. (why: Finish stage drops to 70.1% conversion, and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or confusion about desktop positioning.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In to Post-Waiting Stage: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after pet background rendering completes, right before the home desktop handoff. (why: Moving sign-in later improved adoption conversion in earlier tests, while reducing friction prior to initial pet creation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Session Warning Banner: Add a prominent account session persistence notice on sign-in reassuring users that logging in preserves existing pet data without resets. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about pets disappearing or resetting after signing back in.)
3: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Ownership Preservation Guarantee: Update the adoption certificate headline and hint copy to emphasize automatic pet progress backup and account save protection. (why: Adoption step conversion is only 68.9%, and users report anxiety regarding lost pets.)
4: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Stage Notification Prompt: Enable desktop notification updates and background progress status on the waiting screen so users know when generation finishes. (why: The waiting screen has a long mean duration (2336s), causing drop-offs when users leave the screen unattended.)
5: [finish, notification] System Tray Mascot Control Alert Tip: Add a delayed system tray hint card on the home intro screen demonstrating how to hide, show, or wake the desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails indicated confusion after setup on how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Choice Checklist Selection Layout: Change the path selection screen layout to a structured checklist format highlighting key differences between preset and custom paths. (why: 85.3% conversion on path choice with a high mean duration (514s) shows user hesitation between options.)

scores.note: Target step finish has a high drop-off (29.9%), but adding interactive new screens/flows historically severely hurt conversion (-14.4%).
Post-waiting room sign-in explicitly hurt conversion (-3.9%) in past tests and sign-in already has low drop-off.
Strongly supported by top customer issue (8 emails); account recovery copy historically yielded +4.2% lift.
Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (31.1%); copy reassurance around pet recovery has strong precedent.
Addresses long wait times (2336s); background readiness status updates consistently provided positive gains (+3.3%).
Finish stage drop-off is high, but tray control tips and notifications historically had negative or neutral results (-1.3%).
Addresses high decision duration on path choice (514s); layout enhancements on choose_path averaged +2.4% historical lift.
